verdict.rationale: Khoj's docs say it can be self-hosted on consumer hardware. They document installing the server via Docker or pip, offline use on a personal computer, customization, and a server admin panel. Community users report running a local instance, though one person hit a Docker/pip build failure and another found it heavy on an M2 MacBook Air. missing for 10: consistently reliable install experience (reported Docker/pip build failure), evidence of acceptable local performance on modest hardware.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: You can self-host on consumer hardware for privacy
You can install the Khoj server using either Docker or Pip
you can always choose to run Khoj on your own hardware, and never share your data outside of your device
You can even use Khoj without an internet connection if deployed on your personal computer.
The admin panel allows you to configure various settings for your Khoj server.
